preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the token to transfer

exploit_hint: The contract inherits from Ownable but doesn't use onlyOwner modifier on critical functions like _mint, _burn, or _setupDecimals. An attacker can call _mint() directly to mint unlimited tokens to themselves, increasing their balance. Simply call _mint(attacker_address, large_amount) to exploit the missing access control.
